definitions.usage: arrogancy, excellency(-lent), majesty, pomp, pride, proud, swelling.
definitions.full: H1347. ga 'own גָּאוֺן noun masculine Hosea 5:5 exaltation — Job 40:10 5 t.; construct גְּאוֺן Lev 26:19 31 t.; suffix גְּאוֺנְךָ etc. Exod 15:7 9 t.; plural suffix גְּאוֺנָ֑יִךְ Ezek 16:56 ; — 1 exaltation, majesty, excellence , a. of nations, their wealth, power, magnificence of buildings , e.g. Egypt Ezek 32:12 , Chaldeans Isa 13:11 , 19 ; 14:11 , Philistines Zech 9:6 , Assyria 10:11 , Jacob Psa 47:5 ; Amos 6:8 ; 8:7 ; Nahum 2:3 , Israel Hosea 5:5 ; 7:10 (probably appellation of ׳י ), Nahum 2:3 , Judah Jer 13:9 , Jerusalem 13:9 ; Ezek 16:56 ; עֻזָּהּ גְּאוֺן pride of her strength 30:6 , 18 ; 33:28 ; עזים גאון 7:24 (but ᵐ5 Ew Hi Co read עזם ); עזכם גאון Lev 26:19 ; Ezek 24:21 ; the fruit of land of Judah will become ולתפארת לגאון majestic and beautiful Isa 4:2 ; צבי כל גאון the majesty of all the splendour (of Tyre) 23:9 ; Zion is to become עולם גאון an everlasting excellency 60:15 . b. of God Exod 15:7 ; Isa 24:14 ; Micah 5:3 ; גְּאֹנוֺ הֲדַר Isa 2:10 , 19 , 21 ; גְּאוֺנוֺ בְּקוֺל יַרְעֵם Job 37:4 ; וָגֹבַהּ גָּאוֺן נָא עֲדֵה 40:10 . c. הירדן גאון majesty of Jordan , referring to the green and shady banks, clothed with willows, tamarisks, and cane, in which the lions made their covert Jer 49:19 ; 50:44 ; Zech 11:3 , and therefore dangerous Jer 12:5 (Ew thinks of the swelling of its agitated waters); גַּלֶּיךָ גְּאוֺן majesty of thy waves Job 38:11 . 2 pride (bad sense) Job 35:12 ; Psa 59:13 ; Prov 8:13 ; 16:18 ; Ezek 7:20 ; 16:49 ; Zeph 2:10 ; of Moab Isa 16:6 (twice in verse) = Jer 48:29 (twice in verse).
